claims.quote: Numerous genes have been identified as a monogenic cause of DEE, including KCNB1.

The voltage-gated potassium channel KV2.1, encoded by KCNB1, is primarily responsible for delayed rectifier potassium currents that are important regulators of excitability in electrically excitable cells, including neurons.
KV2.1 also serves a highly conserved structural function organizing endoplasmic reticulum-plasma membrane junctions clustered in the soma and proximal dendrites of neurons.

claims.object_text: epileptic spasms and atonic, focal and tonic-clonic seizures refractory to standard antiepileptic drugs
claims.quote: The de novo pathogenic variant KCNB1-p.G379R was identified in an infant with epileptic spasms, and atonic, focal and tonic-clonic seizures that were refractory to treatment with standard antiepileptic drugs.
Previous work demonstrated deficits in potassium conductance, but did not assess non-conducting functions.
KV2.1-G379R expression did not induce formation of endoplasmic reticulum-plasma membrane junctions,
co-expression of KV2.1-G379R with KV2.1-wild-type lowered induction of these structures relative to KV2.1-WT alone, consistent with a dominant negative effect.
To model this variant in vivo, we introduced Kcnb1G379R into mice using CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing.

claims.object_text: genotype-dependent differences in expression levels of KV2.1, KV2.2 and AMIGO-1 proteins
claims.quote: Immunohistochemistry studies on brains from Kcnb1+/+, Kcnb1R/+ and Kcnb1R/R mice revealed genotype-dependent differences in the expression levels of KV2.1 protein, as well as associated KV2.2 and AMIGO-1 proteins.

claims.object_text: hyperactivity, repetitive behaviors, impulsivity and reduced anxiety
claims.quote: Kcnb1R/+ and Kcnb1R/R mice displayed profound hyperactivity, repetitive behaviors, impulsivity and reduced anxiety.

claims.object_text: spontaneous seizures and seizures induced by exposure to novel environments and/or handling
claims.quote: Spontaneous seizures were observed in Kcnb1R/R mice, as well as seizures induced by exposure to novel environments and/or handling.
Both Kcnb1R/+ and Kcnb1R/R mutants were more susceptible to proconvulsant-induced seizures.

claims.object_text: abnormal interictal EEG activity, including isolated spike and slow waves
claims.quote: both Kcnb1R/+ and Kcnb1R/R mice exhibited abnormal interictal EEG activity, including isolated spike and slow waves.

claims.object_text: recapitulate many features observed in individuals with DEE due to pathogenic variants in KCNB1
claims.quote: Overall, the Kcnb1G379R mice recapitulate many features observed in individuals with DEE due to pathogenic variants in KCNB1.

claims.object_text: therapies to treat this pharmacoresistant DEE
claims.quote: will provide a valuable tool for the development of therapies to treat this pharmacoresistant DEE.
